theme_description: A high-contrast interface designed for technical precision. The outer panels (Jobs and Actions) utilize a deep 'Obsidian' dark theme to feel like an elite control center, while the central Workspace uses a crisp, high-contrast light theme to mimic physical engineering documents and maximize map legibility.

rules: No Inter or Roboto for headings. Use Chivo for authoritative, technical headers.
Headings (H1, H2) must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) and font-medium to font-bold.
Overlines, TMM Citations, and Status Badges must be Uppercase, text-xs, Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]), and use JetBrains Mono.
Never center-align paragraphs or dense engineering content. Left-align for readability.
Line height: tight (leading-none) for headings, loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Avoid pure #000000; use #0A0A0A (Obsidian) for deep backgrounds.
Use #FF5F15 (Safety Orange) deliberately and sparingly—only for primary AI generation actions and critical map/closure markers.
Ensure APCA minimum contrast ratios. Text on #FF5F15 must be black or very dark gray.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces that have content scrolling beneath.

details.sidebar_left: w-72 or w-80 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#0A0A0A] border-r border-white/10 h-full overflow-y-auto flex flex-col p-4
details.workspace_center: flex-1 bg-[#F8F9FA] h-full overflow-y-auto relative p-8 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] z-10
details.panel_right: w-80 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#0A0A0A] border-l border-white/10 h-full overflow-y-auto flex flex-col p-6

rules: The left and right panels must feel like technical control surfaces (Dark Theme).
The center workspace must feel like an illuminated drafting table (Light Theme) containing the Leaflet Map and AI-generated TMM plan.
Never use full-screen gradients. Use solid structural colors with 1px borders (Grid Borders style) for separation.
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch to match their neighbors.
Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.

component_rules.buttons: Sharp rectangular corners (rounded-sm or rounded-none) for a rigid, engineering feel. Primary AI actions (e.g., Generate Plan) must be solid Safety Orange with subtle glow. Secondary actions use 1px solid border.
component_rules.cards: Cardless, dense rectangular styles. Use 1px borders (border-black/10 on light, border-white/10 on dark). No soft shadows; rely on crisp edges.
component_rules.badges: For status (Draft, Pending, Approved), use JetBrains Mono, text-xs, uppercase, with hard 1px borders and slight background tint of the status color.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to be dense. Inputs should have flat backgrounds (bg-black/50 on dark side, bg-white on light side) with focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary. No thick rings.
component_rules.map: Leaflet map must be embedded in the center workspace. Use a custom map tile style (e.g., CartoDB Positron or a desaturated blueprint style) to match the stark aesthetic. Markers should be high-contrast SVG nodes.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (Technical Look) for the left jobs sidebar to expose the skeleton. Items should have border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid muddy transparent backgrounds. If a sticky header is used in the center workspace, use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a 1px border-b border-black/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise overlay (opacity-10 to 20) on the dark panels to make them feel physical and matte.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color change. Buttons should have rapid, snappy transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease).
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for the Jobs list on the left.
motion.tabs: Smooth crossfade when switching between 'Map View' and 'Plan Document' in the center workspace.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. Muted text must still be legible (e.g., #A1A1AA on #0A0A0A).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a high-contrast focus state (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF5F15]).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Provide aria-hidden for purely decorative map elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid="generate-plan-button"`).

image_urls.description: Aerial view of a city street intersection
image_urls.category: Login Page Background / Auth Split Screen
Workspace Empty State or Admin Knowledge Base Background

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a highly legible, technical look suitable for dense dashboards.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for this 2D map/document heavy tool. Do not overcomplicate with 3D unless rendering physical barricade models.
3d_libraries.map_library: react-leaflet (Leaflet) is mandatory per problem statement. Ensure map tiles are high-contrast (e.g., standard OSM or Carto light_all).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react leaflet react-leaflet lucide-react`.
Use Shadcn UI for form elements, dropdowns, and dialogs. Strip default Vercel aesthetic and apply the crisp, dense 1px border style.
Implement the Three-Panel layout meticulously: Left (Jobs sidebar), Center (Workspace canvas - light theme), Right (Actions/AI controls - dark theme).
The center workspace must elegantly present the Client Request Form, the TMM Plan document, and the Leaflet Map depending on the selected job context.
Ensure the TMM citations generated by A.T.O.M. are visually distinct (e.g., using JetBrains Mono, small text, highlighted background).
Apply optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., slightly adjust padding for buttons with icons).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (e.g., the bright center workspace floating between the dark side panels).
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js` or similar.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Maintain a clear visual hierarchy. Use contrasting sizes and weights for typography to guide the user's eye from the most critical TMM citations down to supporting details.
Feedback loops should be immediate. Approvals, rejections, or AI generations should provide instant visual confirmation (e.g., toast notifications via sonner).
Ensure inputs and actionable items have enough padding for ease of clicking (minimum 44px height for primary CTAs).
Make data legible. Traffic engineering data involves dense metrics (volume, speed, lanes); use tabular layouts with mono-spaced numbers for scannability.
